comment: Blood Sun step 5 (design §9.2): Dimir Machinations on our own library, top Swamp, Swamp, Lightning Bolt, opponent at 3. Exiling both Swamps puts the Bolt on top: drawn on turn 4 and cast with the Mountain -- a turn-4 kill (untouched, the Bolt is drawn on turn 6). The disposition is SEARCHED (the reorder pin's 16-way fan), so the search finds it whatever the provider's default keeps. d3, budget 100.
